## Ctx.answerPreCheckout() method

Answers the current pre-checkout query, approving or rejecting payment.

**Signature:**

```typescript
answerPreCheckout(ok: boolean, errorMessage?: string | null): Promise<true>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;true&gt;

`true` on success.

## Remarks

Thin passthrough to `api.answerPreCheckoutQuery` for the active update — no template involved. Call from `handleFreePreCheckoutQuery` (or `handleSessionFreePreCheckoutQuery`<!-- -->); the Bot API must receive the answer within 10 seconds of the query. Programmer error (no active pre-checkout query) always throws, never falls back.

why-not-base: simplified `(ok, errorMessage?)` shape with a fail-fast page-named throw; base `Context.answerPreCheckoutQuery` needs manual `other` shaping.

  await this.answerPreCheckout(true)
}
